vocabulary.meaning_en: something that helps you; take advantage = use a chance
vocabulary.example: Take advantage of the sunny weather and go outside.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the need or wish of people to buy something
vocabulary.example: There is a big demand for electric cars.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to say good things about someone
to make something sound bigger or better than it is
vocabulary.example: Don't exaggerate – it wasn't that bad!

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small tool for spreading cement or digging
the end part of a shirt sleeve
vocabulary.example: There is a button on each cuff.
I need to prepare for my speech.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a range of numbers used to measure something
vocabulary.example: Rate the film on a scale of 1 to 10.
It's my fault we were late.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to do something without planning it first
vocabulary.example: I forgot my notes, so I had to improvise.
Nothing grows in this stony field.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an idea that you offer to others
vocabulary.example: Do you have any suggestions for the trip?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to pay no attention to something
to laugh at someone in a playful way
vocabulary.example: My brother likes to tease me about my hair.
The new rule is unpopular with students.

fine_lines.title: off the cuff vs on the fly
fine_lines.explanation_ar: off the cuff: تقول شيئاً دون تحضير مسبق (كلام، خطاب، تعليق). on the fly: تقرّر وتتصرّف أثناء قيامك بالعمل نفسه، مع تعديل الخطة وأنت تتحرك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Off the cuff' means saying something without preparing it (a speech, a comment). 'On the fly' means deciding and changing things while you are already doing them.

examples.sentence: He gave an off-the-cuff speech at the dinner.
We changed the route on the fly because of traffic.

fine_lines.title: that's on you vs this is on me
fine_lines.explanation_ar: that's on you = هذا خطؤك ومسؤوليتك. أما this is on me فتعني «أنا سأدفع» (الطعام أو الشراب).
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'That's on you' means it's your fault. 'This is on me' means 'I will pay' (usually for food or drinks).

examples.sentence: You didn't check the time, so missing the train is on you.
Put your wallet away – lunch is on me.

fine_lines.title: lay it on thick vs have someone on
fine_lines.explanation_ar: lay it on thick: تبالغ في المديح أو المشاعر. have someone on: تمازح شخصاً وتجعله يصدق شيئاً غير صحيح.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Lay it on thick' means to praise too much or exaggerate feelings. 'Have someone on' means to joke and make someone believe something untrue.

examples.sentence: OK, you like my cake – no need to lay it on so thick!
You won a trip to the moon? You're having me on!

expressions.meaning_ar: يستغل وضعاً أو فرصة لكسب المال
expressions.meaning_en: to use a situation to make money
expressions.example: The shop cashed in on the hot weather by selling cheap fans.

expressions.meaning_ar: يبالغ في المديح أو في إظهار المشاعر
expressions.meaning_en: to praise someone too much or exaggerate a feeling
expressions.example: He said I was the best cook in the world – he was laying it on a bit thick.

expressions.phrase: lay it on with a trowel
expressions.meaning_ar: يبالغ جداً (صيغة أقل شيوعاً من lay it on thick)
expressions.meaning_en: a less common form of 'lay it on thick'
expressions.example: In her thank-you speech, she really laid it on with a trowel.
I had to answer the question off the cuff.

expressions.meaning_ar: أكثر بكثير من المتوقع، فوق كل المقاييس
expressions.meaning_en: extremely high; much more than expected
expressions.example: The noise from the crowd was off the scale.

expressions.phrase: that's on you / it's on you
expressions.meaning_en: it's your fault or your responsibility
expressions.example: I told you to bring an umbrella. If you get wet, that's on you.
Don't worry about the bill – this is on me.

expressions.meaning_ar: أثناء العمل نفسه، بسرعة ودون تخطيط مسبق
expressions.meaning_en: deciding or doing something while you are already busy doing it, without planning
expressions.example: I didn't have a plan, so I made the decisions on the fly.

expressions.meaning_ar: يُقابَل الاقتراح أو الفكرة بالرفض أو التجاهل
expressions.meaning_en: when an idea or suggestion is ignored or not welcomed
expressions.example: My idea of a Saturday class fell on stony ground.

expressions.meaning_ar: يمازح شخصاً ويجعله يصدق شيئاً غير صحيح
expressions.meaning_en: to joke with someone by making them believe something untrue
expressions.example: You've met the king? Are you having me on?

grammar.title: Fixed prepositions in idioms: on / off
grammar.explanation_ar: في التعابير الاصطلاحية لا نغيّر حرف الجر: off the cuff (وليس on the cuff)، on the fly، off the scale. بعض التعابير تقبل مفعولاً: cash in on + شيء، have + شخص + on: He's having me on. ويمكن أن يأتي off-the-cuff صفة قبل الاسم مع الشرطات: an off-the-cuff remark.
grammar.explanation_en: Prepositions in idioms are fixed: 'off the cuff' (not 'on the cuff'), 'on the fly', 'off the scale'. Some idioms take an object: cash in on + something; have + person + on: He's having me on. Before a noun, use hyphens: an off-the-cuff remark.
examples: They cashed in on the trend.

questions.question: 'I'll pay for dinner.' Which expression means the same?
questions.explanation_ar: this is on me = أنا سأدفع.
questions.explanation_en: 'This is on me' means I will pay.

questions.question: He spoke without any notes or preparation. He spoke ___.
'The celebrations were off the scale.' What does it mean?
choices: They were much bigger than expected.
questions.explanation_ar: off the scale = فوق المتوقع بكثير.
questions.explanation_en: 'Off the scale' means far beyond what was expected.

questions.question: Companies often ___ popular events by selling special products.
questions.explanation_ar: cash in on = يستغل الفرصة لكسب المال.
questions.explanation_en: 'Cash in on' means use a situation to make money.

questions.question: 'You've won a free car? You're having me on!' The speaker thinks...
choices: it is a joke and not true.
questions.explanation_ar: have someone on = يمازحه بشيء غير صحيح.
questions.explanation_en: 'Have someone on' means joke by saying something untrue.

questions.question: My suggestion to start work at 6 am ___. Nobody liked it.
questions.explanation_ar: fall on stony ground = تُرفض الفكرة أو تُتجاهل.
questions.explanation_en: 'Fall on stony ground' means the idea is ignored or disliked.

questions.question: Which sentence means 'it's your fault'?
choices: We did it on the fly.
questions.explanation_en: 'That's on you' means it's your fault.

questions.question: 'You're the cleverest, kindest, most wonderful boss ever!' This person is ___.
questions.explanation_ar: lay it on thick = يبالغ في المديح.
questions.explanation_en: 'Lay it on thick' means praising too much.

questions.question: We didn't have a plan, so we made changes ___.
questions.explanation_ar: on the fly = أثناء العمل ودون تخطيط.
questions.explanation_en: 'On the fly' means while doing it, without planning.

questions.question: Which is correct before a noun?
questions.explanation_ar: قبل الاسم نستخدم الشرطات: an off-the-cuff remark.
questions.explanation_en: Before a noun we use hyphens: an off-the-cuff remark.
